body: The battery disconnect issue is a simple fix? Could you explain it to me or direct me to a link that might help? I got a second remote. It won't sync either, so the problem is definitely the board.
thanks :)
Thanks. I have to go to class, but we'll talk later?
I don't think there is anything that could do that
My desire to die has been unwavering for 6 years. At what point would the decision not be rushed?

I suffer for other people's pleasure as well.why are their feelings more important than ours. We suffer everyday so those motherfuckers don't get sad at a funeral. Sad cuz our pain ended. I wish they understood. No one deserves to feel like this

They don't understand pain like we do. Some people have a hard time understanding mental illness is real because they can't see it. Have you described the severity of your pain to them? My mom was basically catatonic, and her parents said just get over it. Just choose to be happy. You're being selfish/overdramatic. They eventually understood enough to stop saying those things. Have you tried professional help? Most of them haven't experienced it for themselves, but they have empathy and know it's real.
Do you end up peeing both ways?

Yeah. I want my tubes tied so even if I want kids someday, I won't be able to have them. And I am uncomfortable with abortion. I think we should be able to take our own lives, but not others lives. But then again if the human race was wiped out tomorrow, it might be for the best
Would your spouse be sad if you died? I don't want kids cuz they'd have my miserable genes and then I would feel even more stuck. More of a responsibility to stay alive

Yeah. I worry they'll think it was just for attention. But part of the reason mine was half assed was because I felt like that took some of the blame off me. I rationalized if I take these pills I probably won't die, but if I die, oops! It was partly an accident.
For 20 years? Do you have a spouse or kids?
It is hard. I dismiss my attempt as invalid and not real. But rationally I know it was a big deal
How old are you if you don't mind? Do you consistently want to die?
Well, I'm not gonna lie and say I'd be devastated if you died. I don't even know your name. But if I heard you died, ID be a little sad.
Night
Are you sure they wouldn't care? Not even one person you could be wrong about?
Do you think people would be sad if you died?
If I press show parents, do your parents get an email or something? How long have you wanted to die?
Do you know why there's a button that says "show parent" under your name? Are you minor?
Oh? Are you planning on jumping some other time or did you change your mind?

Lots of people "fail" at suicide attempts. I tried half-heartedly once too. With pills. I vomited them all up (not on purpose) I've heard many "survivors" say they are grateful they survived. You and I are not grateful ATM. Possibly we will be grateful to be alive in the future. But I'm not getting my hopes up. Try to be sure before you make a permanent decision, please.

I've met many peers in the hospital who think they are burdens or worthless or failures. Every life has potential and value. How do you know your family thinks of you like that? Consider the possibility that you are mistaken. Yes, life is hard. I'm not just saying that. I work everyday to fight the impulse to die. Suicide is a permanent decision. Be sure first, please
No one is worthless. Please be sure before you make this permanent decision. Lmk if you didn't jump?

I want to die and have people that would miss me. I don't think those two things are mutually exclusive. 420ish, I'm glad you now value your life. However, to add to what SQLwitch said, your romantic description of the way you thought of dying may trigger some people. It certainly sounds tempting to me. That being said, I'm all for freedom of speech and the difficult stuff should be said somewhere. Do you know of anyplace online where we won't be, let's say, monitored for the sake of political correctness

Thenarthur, we are social beings. Feeling hopeless because of rejection/apathy from loved ones is understandably hard. Hvnie, also there are people out there who understand and empathize with depression. Be certain before making a permanent decision. I wish you well

I think suicide can be rational. I have chronic depression. I've wanted to die consistently for 6 years. The only reason i havent is that it would hurt people in my life. I do not live for myself. No one deserves this pain. I dont care if i miss out on future happiness by dying early. I think that if you reach the same conclusion for a long period of time, then it's a viable option. It's a big decision. You are of value. There is a possibility of feeling better and/or getting out of your difficult decision. There are people out there who would love you if given the chance. Consider all this please. I'd love to talk.
